newsitem.title: USA: Marcus Corp unit to accelerate growth plan.
newsitem.headline: Marcus Corp unit to accelerate growth plan.

text.p: Marcus Theaters, a division of Marcus Corp, on Tuesday said it planned to double the size of its movie screen network in Wisconsin, Illinois and Michigan in the next two and a half years.
The company plans to have 500 screens in operation in the Midwest by 2000, having expanding the number of screens by 32 percent last year.
Construction is scheduled to begin this spring on a 14-screen complex in Utica, Michigan, and the company announced a 16-screen theater in the Detroit area.
Marcus currently operates 297 screens in WIsconsin and Illinois.
The company's shares closed off 1/4 at 22-3/8.
